svg.title: ADAS pipeline DAG
svg.desc: Six stages. Camera branch: image denoise, then lane segmentation and 2D vehicle detection, then lane geometry and mono depth. LiDAR branch: point filter, then 3D vehicle detection. Lead fusion combines 3D detections, mono depth and lane geometry, then feeds ACC. LKA takes lane geometry. The behavior planner merges ACC and LKA into the plan.
svg.text: Classical: KF, control law, state machine
